body.statement: For a causal MPDAG \(G\) and disjoint node sets \(X,Y\), the procedure in Theorem 3 of Guo and Perkovic returns finitely many MPDAGs whose represented-DAG sets partition \([G]\), within each of which the total effect of \(X\) on \(Y\) is identified; for any two distinct output MPDAGs, some observational density consistent with \(G\) makes their identified effects different.

attestation.note: The three-part partition, within-block identification, and between-block separation guarantee is paraphrased directly from Theorem 3 in the cited PMLR source.
